facts.claim: Hans Grundberg, the UN Secretary-General’s Special Envoy for Yemen, said that in the weeks before 9 October 2026 Yemen had slid back into full-scale war, with hostilities spreading across multiple frontlines.
facts.subject: Conflict in Yemen
facts.date_or_period: The weeks before 9 October 2026; statement made 9 October 2026
facts.conditions: An assessment attributed to the Special Envoy. 【主体】Hans Grundberg, Special Envoy of the Secretary-General for Yemen
facts.source_title: Yemen has returned to full-scale war, Special Envoy warns | DPPA
facts.ambiguity: The source gives no exact start date or count of frontlines.
facts.notes_for_writer: Attribute the full-scale-war characterization to Grundberg; do not present the quoted assessment as an independently verified classification. 【背景】The Security Council met to discuss the situation in Yemen on 9 October 2026.

facts.claim: Grundberg said that after Ansar Allah advances on Mokha and the coast along Bab al-Mandab, intense fighting continued in the highlands west and south of Taiz city and into Lahj; he also said fighting had intensified in Marib, al-Jawf and Hajjah.
facts.subject: Fighting in Yemen
facts.date_or_period: As reported on 9 October 2026; the source does not give exact dates for the advances or fighting
facts.scope: Mokha, the coast along Bab al-Mandab, areas west and south of Taiz city, Lahj, Marib, al-Jawf and Hajjah
facts.conditions: Reported by the UN Special Envoy for Yemen. 【主体】Ansar Allah (for the advances named in the statement)
facts.source_title: Yemen has returned to full-scale war, Special Envoy warns | DPPA
facts.notes_for_writer: The source reports the sequence and locations; it does not provide independent verification or further detail about the fighting. 【背景】The statement described hostilities as spreading across multiple frontlines in Yemen.

facts.claim: Grundberg said that the Government had launched a large-scale counter-offensive earlier that week and had since reported retaking areas around Bab al-Mandab.
facts.subject: Government counter-offensive and reported territorial retaking
facts.date_or_period: Earlier in the week before 9 October 2026
facts.conditions: The retaking of areas is reported by the Government, as relayed by the Special Envoy. 【主体】The Government of Yemen
facts.source_title: Yemen has returned to full-scale war, Special Envoy warns | DPPA
facts.ambiguity: The source does not specify the exact date, forces involved, or extent of the areas reportedly retaken.
facts.notes_for_writer: Preserve the attribution that the Government reported retaking the areas; the source does not independently confirm control.

facts.claim: Grundberg said Ansar Allah had carried out deadly attacks against civilian and energy infrastructure in Saudi Arabia.
facts.subject: Attacks on infrastructure in Saudi Arabia
facts.date_or_period: As reported on 9 October 2026; no specific attack dates are given
facts.scope: Civilian and energy infrastructure in Saudi Arabia
facts.conditions: Reported by the UN Special Envoy for Yemen. 【主体】Ansar Allah
facts.source_title: Yemen has returned to full-scale war, Special Envoy warns | DPPA
facts.ambiguity: No specific sites, dates, or casualty figures for these attacks are provided in this statement.
facts.notes_for_writer: Attribute the report to Grundberg; do not add details from other events unless supported by their own sources. 【背景】The statement discussed the intensification of fighting in several areas of Yemen.

facts.claim: Grundberg said Ansar Allah had threatened Saudi-linked commercial ships in the Red Sea and that these threats undermined freedom of navigation.
facts.subject: Threats against commercial ships
facts.date_or_period: As reported on 9 October 2026; no specific dates for the threats are given
facts.scope: Saudi-linked commercial ships in the Red Sea
facts.conditions: The effect on freedom of navigation is the Special Envoy’s stated assessment. 【主体】Ansar Allah
facts.source_title: Yemen has returned to full-scale war, Special Envoy warns | DPPA
facts.notes_for_writer: Attribute the impact on freedom of navigation to Grundberg; the source does not give details of particular threats or ships. 【背景】Grundberg said the threats were becoming enmeshed with the broader confrontation over control of maritime trade routes and stresses on the international energy market.

facts.claim: Grundberg said that attacks earlier in the week on Riyadh and Abha airports had also killed and injured civilians.
facts.subject: Earlier attacks on airports in Saudi Arabia
facts.date_or_period: Earlier in the week before 11 October 2026
facts.scope: Riyadh and Abha airports, Saudi Arabia
facts.conditions: The statement gives no casualty counts for these earlier attacks.
facts.source_title: Statement by UN Special Envoy for Yemen, Hans Grundberg, on latest attacks against Saudi Arabia | OSESGY
facts.ambiguity: The source does not specify the dates of the earlier attacks or the number of civilians killed or injured.
facts.notes_for_writer: Do not attach the casualty figures for the 10 October King Khalid International Airport attack to these earlier attacks. 【背景】The Special Envoy’s 11 October statement followed the attack on King Khalid International Airport on 10 October.

facts.claim: Saudi Arabia’s General Authority of Civil Aviation said the 10 October attack on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh caused 12 fatalities; the statement listed four Saudi citizens and people of Bangladeshi, American, Egyptian, Jordanian, Syrian, Palestinian and Sudanese nationalities among those killed.
facts.subject: Fatalities in the King Khalid International Airport attack
facts.date_or_period: Attack on 10 October 2026; follow-up statement issued 11 October 2026
facts.scope: People killed in the attack targeting King Khalid International Airport, Riyadh
facts.conditions: Figures and nationality details are attributed to GACA. 【主体】General Authority of Civil Aviation (GACA)
facts.numeric_value: 12 fatalities; four Saudi citizens; two Bangladeshi; one each American, Egyptian, Jordanian, Syrian, Palestinian and Sudanese
facts.numeric_scope: Fatalities from the 10 October 2026 airport attack, as specified in the GACA statement
facts.source_title: GACA Follow-up Statement on the Attack Targeting King Khalid International Airport (SPA via OANA)
facts.notes_for_writer: Use the figures and nationality descriptions as attributed to GACA; do not infer details about the victims beyond the statement. 【背景】The statement was a follow-up to GACA’s earlier statement about the attack.

facts.claim: GACA said the 10 October attack on King Khalid International Airport left 309 people injured, including individuals in critical condition.
facts.subject: Injuries in the King Khalid International Airport attack
facts.date_or_period: Attack on 10 October 2026; follow-up statement issued 11 October 2026
facts.scope: People injured in the attack targeting King Khalid International Airport, Riyadh
facts.conditions: The number is attributed to GACA; the statement does not quantify how many injured people were in critical condition. 【主体】General Authority of Civil Aviation (GACA)
facts.numeric_scope: People injured in the 10 October 2026 airport attack
facts.source_title: GACA Follow-up Statement on the Attack Targeting King Khalid International Airport (SPA via OANA)
facts.ambiguity: The number of injured people in critical condition is not specified.
facts.notes_for_writer: A separate UN statement described the number as over 300; this GACA follow-up gives the figure as 309.

facts.claim: GACA said the attack on King Khalid International Airport caused property damage, the extent of which was still being assessed.
facts.subject: Property damage at King Khalid International Airport
facts.date_or_period: Attack on 10 October 2026; GACA statement issued 11 October 2026
facts.conditions: The extent of the damage was being assessed at the time of the statement.
facts.source_title: GACA Follow-up Statement on the Attack Targeting King Khalid International Airport (SPA via OANA)
facts.ambiguity: The statement gives no estimate of the amount or extent of property damage.

facts.claim: SABA reported that the Marib Governorate Media Office said Houthi militias had launched nine ballistic missiles and seven other projectiles at several residential neighborhoods in Marib city.
facts.subject: Reported projectiles directed at residential neighborhoods in Marib
facts.date_or_period: Evening of 15 October 2026, according to the source
facts.scope: Several residential neighborhoods in Marib city
facts.conditions: The report attributes the claim to the Marib Governorate Media Office. 【主体】Houthi militias, as identified in the report
facts.numeric_scope: Projectiles the Media Office reported were launched at residential neighborhoods in Marib city
facts.source_title: Houthi Terrorist Militias Fire 16 Ballistic Missiles, Projectiles on Residential Areas in Marib City (SABA)
facts.ambiguity: The report does not provide independent verification of the Media Office’s account.
facts.notes_for_writer: Attribute the launch claim to the Marib Governorate Media Office as reported by SABA. The source’s headline and wording use politically charged labels; avoid adopting them as an independent characterization. 【背景】The Media Office called on international and humanitarian organizations to condemn the attacks and take steps to stop targeting civilians.

facts.claim: The Aden Capital Security Department said two rockets fired by the Houthi group fell within the compound of Aden International Airport on 16 October 2026; it described the incident as the second of its kind in less than a week.
facts.subject: Rockets falling within Aden International Airport
facts.date_or_period: 16 October 2026; the department said it was the second such incident in less than a week
facts.scope: The compound of Aden International Airport
facts.conditions: The account is from the Aden Capital Security Department. 【主体】The Houthi group, as identified by the Aden Capital Security Department
facts.numeric_value: 2 rockets; second such incident within less than a week
facts.numeric_scope: Rockets reported to have fallen within the airport compound; recurrence described by the department
facts.source_title: توضيح أمني بشأن استهداف مطار عدن الدولي (アデン首都治安局)
facts.ambiguity: The department does not give the date or details of the earlier incident.
facts.notes_for_writer: Keep the claim attributed to the department. The source reports rockets falling inside the compound; it does not specify damage or injuries beyond its preliminary statement. 【背景】The department said the incident posed a threat to civilian facilities and air traffic.

facts.claim: The Aden Capital Security Department said preliminary information indicated no loss of life in the 16 October airport incident.
facts.subject: Reported deaths in the Aden International Airport incident
facts.scope: The incident involving rockets falling within Aden International Airport
facts.conditions: The department described the information as preliminary. 【主体】Aden Capital Security Department
facts.numeric_scope: Deaths in the 16 October 2026 airport incident, according to preliminary information
facts.source_title: توضيح أمني بشأن استهداف مطار عدن الدولي (アデン首都治安局)
facts.ambiguity: The source says the information was preliminary and does not provide a final casualty assessment.
facts.notes_for_writer: Retain the preliminary qualifier; do not state categorically that no one died.

facts.claim: Okaz, quoting a responsible source in the Ministry of Energy, reported that an administrative building belonging to Saudi Aramco in Dhahran was targeted on the evening of 13 October 2026, resulting in a limited fire; the source said there were no injuries or fatalities.
facts.subject: Targeting of a Saudi Aramco administrative building in Dhahran
facts.scope: One administrative building belonging to Saudi Aramco in Dhahran, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia
facts.conditions: The event and casualty information are attributed by Okaz to a responsible source in the Ministry of Energy. 【主体】A responsible source in the Saudi Ministry of Energy, as quoted by Okaz
facts.numeric_scope: Building reported as targeted and casualties reported in that incident
facts.source_title: «الطاقة»: استهداف مبنى إداري تابع لشركة أرامكو السعودية في الظهران دون إصابات (Okaz)
facts.ambiguity: The source does not identify who carried out the targeting or how it was carried out.
facts.notes_for_writer: Attribute the information to the Ministry of Energy source as quoted by Okaz. Do not infer an attacker or method. 【背景】The source said the relevant authorities had responded to the incident and taken necessary measures.

facts.claim: Grundberg said the 10 October attack on King Khalid International Airport represented a grave escalation and posed a serious threat to regional security, perpetuated cycles of violence and further complicated peace efforts for Yemen.
facts.subject: UN Special Envoy’s assessment of the airport attack
facts.date_or_period: Statement issued 11 October 2026 about the 10 October attack
facts.scope: Regional security and peace efforts for Yemen
facts.conditions: These are assessments and stated effects by the UN Special Envoy. 【主体】Hans Grundberg, UN Special Envoy for Yemen
facts.source_title: Statement by UN Special Envoy for Yemen, Hans Grundberg, on latest attacks against Saudi Arabia | OSESGY
facts.notes_for_writer: Attribute these assessments to Grundberg; do not present them as independently measured effects. 【背景】The statement condemned continuing attacks against civilian infrastructure in Saudi Arabia by Ansar Allah.
